capabilities: number labelled figures and equations in Reading view
jump from a resolved reference number to its source line
resolve references that appear before their targets
list labels, missing and duplicate references in a label report
save and load number and prefix profiles and save local label reports (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a Pandoc export tool; it does not run Pandoc or pandoc-crossref and only previews label numbers inside Obsidian's reading view.
extras: Freemium: core numbering and label report are free; Pro (saved profiles, local reports) requires a $5/month or one-time $15 GitHub Sponsors payment to the author, verified via GitHub device-flow sign-in that checks sponsorship tier. After updates the plugin opens a 'What's new' tab that promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off). README notes untested platforms (mobile, Windows/Linux desktop) and that it supports only a limited label grammar (no tables, subfigures, section or cross-note references).
intentEvidence: It does not run Pandoc, install pandoc-crossref or configure an export command. It gives a limited preview of simple labels
problem: Obsidian's reading view shows raw @fig:label and @eq:label syntax instead of the figure and equation numbers that Pandoc cross-referencing would produce on export.

relations.evidence: Does this replace pandoc-crossref? No. This version supports a limited note-local grammar.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Reading-view preview that numbers Pandoc-labelled figures and equations in a note and lets you select a reference number to jump to its source line.
